The Romanian Agency for Investments and Foreign Trade and the Ministry of Education and Research grant each year a number of 40 scholarships to the foreign citizens by an application evaluation-based competition organized according to Romanian regulations, for bachelor’s degree, master, postgraduate/residency (emergency medicine or cardiology specializations only) and PhD studies in accredited state institutions of higher education in Romania.

Qualifying criteria: all foreign citizens with the exception of the EU and EFTA member states. Priority is given to citizens of non-EU and non-EFTA states that don’t have an agreement with Romania for cultural and educational cooperation.

Persons not eligible for this scholarship:

• Romanian citizens or persons that belong to historical Romanian communities located in the vicinity of Romania (they benefit from other programs);

• Citizens that have applied for or are under a form of protection in Romania.

• Stateless persons who are permitted to stay on the Romanian territory and recognized according to the Romanian law;

• Member / family members of diplomatic and consular corps accredited in Romania, member / family members of the administrative and technical personnel of the

diplomatic missions and consular offices accredited in Romania and member / family members of the international organizations represented in Romania;

• Citizens that have benefited from the Romanian state`s scholarship for the same cycle of studies;

acagta ah ee la iska rabo iyo liis ay ku qoran yihiin waxyaabaha cayiman ee kale ee la iska rabo. Qoladda gurigu waa khasab inay gacanta kaaga keenaan ama ay boostadda kuu soo dhigaan ogaysiiska. Waxa aad u isticmaali kartaa ogaysiiska inuu kaa caawiyo inaad heshid gargaar dhanka kiradda ah. Qaar ka mid ah magaalooyinku waxa ay u baahan yihiin bixin ogaysiis intaa ka dheer ka hor inta aysan qoladda gurigu xareysan dacwo. Magaalooyinka, Minneapolis, Saint Louis Park, Brooklyn Center, haddii adigoo ku nool kiro lagugu yeesho, qoladda guriga aad uga jirtaa waa inay ku siiso 30-cisho ka hor inta aysan xareysan dacwo guri ka saarid ah.

Haddii aadan bixin karin cadadka lacagta ah ee ay yiraahdaan waa lagugu leeyahay ka hor aakhirka mudadda ogaysiiska iyo/ama haddii aadan ku raacsanayn cadadka lacagta ah ee ay leeyihiin waa lagugu leeyahay, waxa aad isku dayi kartaa inaad kala shaqeyso waanwaan qoladda guriga si kolkaa aysan uga xareysan dacwo guri ka saarid ah maxkamad. Haddii aad heshiis waanwaan ah aad wada gaartaan qoladda guriga, qoraal ka dhig taa. Hubi in adiga iyo qoladda gurigana aad saxiixdaan. Haddii qoladda aad guriga uga jirtaa ay xareysato dacwo guri ka saarid ah ka hor inta aan heshiiska la dhamaynin, keen heshiiska maxkamadda maalinta maxkamaddu dhacayso. Waydii maxkamaddu inay ansaxiso heshiiska. Waa inaad siddoo kale isku daydo in aad hesho in diiwaanka kiiska dacwada la masaxo (tirtirid) iyadoo taasi ay qayb ka tahay heshiinta. Maxkamadda ha u goyn, xataa haddii aad heshiis la sameysay qoladda guriga. Qoladda gurigu waa ay tagi karaan maxkamadda, haddii aadan adigu joogina, xaakimka waxaa dhici karta inuu amro guri ka saaridda.

Guddiga waxa uu ka kooban yahay toddobo xubnood (7) oo ka kala socda hay’adaha caddaaladda, waxayna u xilsaaran yihiin in ay ka shaqeeyaan qiimeynta iyo ka tala-bixinta marxalada uu marayo Nidaamka IECMS, iyaga oo si toos ah ula shaqayn doona shirkadda hormarineysa systemka ee Agile, muddo afar bilood ah oo ka bilaabaneysa 1/6/2026 kuna eg 01/10/2026, iyagoo u warbixin doona Madaxda Sare ee Caddaaladda, Xubnaha Guddiga waa sidaan:

  • Dib-u-eegista modules-ka iyo functionality-ga IECMS.
  • Aqoonsiga khaladaadka, cilladaha, iyo meelaha maqan.
  • Hubinta waafaqsanaanta nidaamka iyo habraacyada garsoorka.
  • Ka qaybgalka kulamada kooxda dhistay Systemka IECMS.
  • Soo-gudbinta warbixinada iyo xogaha loo baahan yahay.
  • Soo jeedinta xalal iyo talooyin farsamo oo ku saabsan IECMS.
  • Maareynta khataraha iyo isbeddellada soo kordha.
  • Wixii kale ee hawlo ah ee looga baahan yahay IECMS

1.   KULAMADA GUDDIGA

Guddigu waxa uu yeelanayaan kulamo joogto ah, kuwa degdeg ah iyo kuwa gaar gaar ah. Kulamada Joogtada iyo kuwa gaarka ah waxa ay ku furmayaan ugu yaraan kooram dhan afar (4) xubnood oo ka mid ah Guddiga. Halka kulamada deg-degga ah uu ku furmayo hadba inta la heli karo Xubnaha Guddiga.

Kulamada Joogtada ah: Guddigu waxa uu kulmaya todobaadkasta hal mar, kaas oo looga hadli doono waxa u qabsoomay Gudiga iyo qorshayaasha shaqada.

Kulamada gaarka ah: Waxa ay dhacayaan markasta oo loo baahdo in shaqada la dardargliyo, lagu xaliyo arrimo taagan, lana qabanayo shaqo wadajir ah.

Kulamada Deg-dega ah: Waxa ay dhacayaan markasta ay oo soo kordhaan arrimo deg-deg ah oo u baahan in uu Guddiga go’aan ka qaato, si shaqadu u sii socoto.

2.   HABKA GO’AAN QAADASHADA GUDDIGA

Go’aannada guddiga waxaa lagu gaarayaa cod dheeri xubnaha jooga Kulanka, haddii ay simaana waxaa la raacaa dhinaca uu jiro guddoomiyaha.

3.   QORSHAHA SHAQADA (4 Months)


Bisha 1aad

  • Qiimeynta Farqiyada (Gap Assessment)
  • Kala Mudnaansiinta Arrimaha iyo Caqabadaha (Issue Prioritization)
  • Xaqiijinta iyo Dib-u-eegista Liiska Hawlaha Haray (Backlog Validation)

Bisha 2aad

  • Dhamaystirka Shaqooyinka Nidaamka (Functional Completion)
  • Dhamaystirka Isku-xidhka Nidaamyada (Integration Completion)

Bisha 3aad

  • Tijaabinta Aqbalaadda Isticmaalaha (UAT – User Acceptance Testing)
  • Tijaabinta Amniga Nidaamka (Security Testing)
  • Tijaabinta Waxqabadka iyo Xawaaraha Nidaamka (Performance Testing)

Bisha 4aad

  • Tababarka Isticmaalayaasha (Training)
  • Hirgelinta Tijaabada ah (Pilot Deployment)
  • Dib-u-eegista Diyaargarowga Bilaabista Rasmiga ah (Go-Live Readiness Review)

4.   MUDNAANTA MODULES-KA

1.    Qeybta Kiisaska Ciqaabta (Criminal Cases)

2.    Qeybta Kiisaska Madaniga (Civil Cases)

3.    Qeybta Mucaamalaadka (E-Services)

4.    Qeybta Dadweynaha (E-filings)

5.    Lawyers Portal

6.    Reports

Halkan waxaa muhiim ah in shaqada aan loo qaybin xubnaha, balse loo qaybiyo marxalado, waxaana lasoo saari doonaa habraac lagu qeexayo hawlaha la qabanayo marxalad kasta.
